Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; equipment and inspection claims resolve to the first selected page, the brake, signal, exhaust, lamp, hood, horn and mirror claims to the second, and the belt, child restraint, air bag, steering, tire and windshield claims to the third.

Confidence: high across the section; every rule is stated directly on its page. One source-form caution: the age numerals in the child restraint sentence on the third page are rendered graphically in the snapshot rather than as text, so that fact was confirmed against the rendered page, and the auditor should check it visually.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
